messages.subject: Re: Drag and Drop ?
parts:
Well ... the way I setup that function is for sorting (e.g., variable in a dataframe or levels in a factor) not so much selecting. 

I am guess this (http://jqueryui.com/droppable/#shopping-cart) is more like what Sam has in mind. That, to the best of my knowledge, is not available. However, it should be possible to adapt the code at https://github.com/mostly-harmless/sortable to make that happen. 

Just curious ... why would you prefer drag-and-drop for selecting variables over a selectInput with multiple = TRUE ?
